capabilities: Finds every folder named 'meetings' in the vault
Creates a meeting note in a chosen folder
Builds file names from configurable placeholders
Applies an optional template, including Templater commands
Adds a 'New meeting note here' folder context-menu item
extras: Interface ships in 15 languages following Obsidian's language setting; translations live in src/i18n.ts and accept pull requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create a note in one of many same-named meeting folders scattered across project folders.

relations.evidence: If Templater is installed, <% %> commands are run too.

summary: Command that creates a meeting note in any vault folder named 'meetings', with fuzzy folder picker, placeholders and optional template.
